instruction: For every employee listed in the Excel evaluation data, complete a PDF performance review template with their personal and reviewer details. Save each PDF under the employee's name, ensuring Linda Green's PDF contains all her basic information as specified in the spreadsheet.

metadata.explanation: This task verifies basic employee data transfer from Excel to PDF for a specific employee. Verified Linda Green's data from Excel row 5: Employee Name 'Linda Green', ID '44556', Position 'Sales Representative', Department 'Sales', Reviewer Name 'Gary Davis', Reviewer Title 'Sales Manager'. The evaluator checks that all 6 key text fields are correctly present in the PDF file. Performance ratings are not verified for correctness as they would require complex form field mapping and knowledge of the exact Excel rating structure.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 100% for 6 text fields (employee name: Linda Green, ID: 44556, position: Sales Representative, department: Sales, reviewer name: Gary Davis, reviewer title: Sales Manager = 16.67% each). Performance ratings are not part of the verification.
